column1: # TITLE: A novel DNA methylation disruption contributes to ALKi resistance in NSCLC
# SUMMARY: Acquired resistance to ALKi in NSCLC patients is attributed to gain of mutations in the ALK-EML4 fusion gene and an enhancement of the EGFR and/or IGF1R pathways. Here
column2: we explain the epigenetic change that drives the EGFR and IGF1R reactivation in the absence of the appearance of an ALK-EML4 mutated scenario.
